name: com.nus.design-system
description: A design system for uGUI: one theme of colour, size and type tokens, styles and variants for buttons, toggles, panels and drag cards, a scanner that styles existing controls with no visible change, a Check that catches broken layouts and text that doesn't fit, before/after Style Proposals, and a three-way Figma sync that never overwrites the game's own adaptations.

samples.description: Presets a new project's design system starts from (Neutral, Bold). Import to copy one and make your own; Tools > Design System > Set Up New Project... uses them without importing.
